name: taste-fork
description: A critic with Jeff's taste reads each deliverable once after it is written and hands its findings back to the agent to fix.

globs.title: Files to review
globs.description: Comma-separated globs. A glob without a leading **/ or drive matches at any depth, and braces list alternatives. Negation is not supported. A Write or Edit to a matching path gets one critic pass per session. An Artifact publish gets its own pass when its text is new.

criticModel.title: Critic model
criticModel.description: The model alias or full id the critic runs on.
